name: Overnight Oats with Blueberries and Almonds
steps: Stir oats, almond milk, chia seeds, and maple syrup in a jar.
Top with blueberries and sliced almonds before serving cold.

name: Peanut Banana Toast
steps: Top with banana slices, cinnamon, and pumpkin seeds.

name: Greek Yogurt Berry Parfait
steps: Layer yogurt, berries, and granola in a glass.
Finish with mint and serve chilled.

name: Savory Tofu Breakfast Scramble
steps: Crumble tofu into a bowl and season with turmeric and salt.
Sauté onion and bell pepper in olive oil for 3 minutes.
Add tofu and cook until warmed through, then fold in spinach until wilted.

name: Mushroom and Spinach Egg Muffins
steps: Preheat oven to 375°F and grease a muffin tin.
Sauté onion and mushrooms in olive oil, then add spinach to wilt.
Whisk eggs with salt and pepper, divide veggies into cups, pour eggs over, and bake 15–18 minutes.

name: Chia Pudding with Mango
steps: Whisk chia seeds, coconut milk, and maple syrup in a bowl.
Refrigerate for at least 4 hours until thick.
Top with diced mango and lime zest.

name: Avocado Radish Rice Cakes
steps: Mash avocado with lemon juice, salt, and pepper.
Top with thinly sliced radish and serve immediately.

name: Cottage Cheese Pineapple Bowl
steps: Spoon cottage cheese into a bowl.
Top with pineapple chunks and chopped walnuts.
Drizzle honey and sprinkle flaxseed before serving.

name: Sweet Potato Breakfast Hash
steps: Dice sweet potato and sauté in olive oil for 8 minutes.
Add onion, paprika, and salt and cook until onion softens.
Stir in kale and cook 2 minutes until tender.

name: Smoked Salmon Cucumber Plate
steps: Slice cucumber and avocado and arrange on a plate.
Add smoked salmon and scatter capers.
Squeeze lemon and garnish with dill.

name: Chicken Lettuce Wrap Lunch
steps: Shred chicken and toss with sesame oil, lime juice, and soy sauce.
Add julienned carrot and cucumber to the chicken mixture.
Spoon into romaine leaves and serve.

name: Quinoa Chickpea Herb Salad
steps: Combine quinoa, chickpeas, diced cucumber, and chopped parsley.
Whisk lemon juice, olive oil, and salt for dressing.
Toss salad with dressing and chill 10 minutes.

name: Turkey Hummus Veggie Wrap
steps: Layer turkey, spinach, bell pepper, and cucumber.
Roll tightly and slice in half.

name: Lentil Carrot Soup
steps: Sauté onion and garlic in olive oil until fragrant.
Add diced carrot, lentils, cumin, and broth.
Simmer 20 minutes until lentils are soft and blend partially for texture.

name: Tuna White Bean Salad
steps: Drain tuna and beans and place in a bowl.
Add chopped celery, onion, and parsley.
Dress with olive oil and lemon juice and toss.

name: Grilled Halloumi Grain Bowl
steps: Pan-sear halloumi slices until golden on both sides.
Sauté zucchini and red pepper in olive oil.
Assemble with rice, halloumi, veggies, lemon juice, and oregano.

name: Tofu Soba Noodle Salad
steps: Cook soba noodles, rinse under cold water, and drain.
Toss noodles, tofu, cabbage, and carrot with soy sauce, sesame oil, and rice vinegar.

name: Egg and Avocado Salad Pita
steps: Chop eggs and mash with avocado, yogurt, and lemon juice.
Season to taste and stir until creamy.
Stuff mixture into pita with lettuce.

name: Shrimp Rice Paper Rolls
steps: Soak rice paper sheets briefly in warm water.
Fill with shrimp, lettuce, carrot, cucumber, and mint.
Roll tightly and serve with peanut sauce.

name: Black Bean Corn Salad Bowl
steps: Combine beans, corn, diced onion, and avocado in a bowl.
Add lime juice, chopped cilantro, and salt.

name: Lemon Herb Chicken with Rice
steps: Cook brown rice according to package directions.
Season chicken with garlic, thyme, lemon zest, and salt and pan-sear until done.
Steam broccoli and serve with sliced chicken over rice.

name: Baked Cod with Potatoes and Green Beans
steps: Preheat oven to 400°F and toss potatoes with olive oil and salt.
Roast potatoes for 20 minutes, then add cod and green beans to the tray.
Season cod with garlic and lemon and bake 12 more minutes.

name: Chickpea Coconut Curry
steps: Sauté onion and garlic in olive oil.
Add curry powder and chickpeas and stir 1 minute.
Pour in coconut milk, simmer 10 minutes, and fold in spinach until wilted.

name: Beef and Broccoli Stir-Fry
steps: Toss beef with cornstarch and a splash of soy sauce.
Stir-fry beef in sesame oil until browned and remove.
Cook broccoli with garlic and ginger, return beef, add remaining soy sauce, and toss.

name: Stuffed Bell Peppers with Lentils
steps: Preheat oven to 375°F and halve bell peppers.
Sauté onion and carrot, then mix with lentils, rice, and paprika.
Fill peppers and bake 25 minutes until tender.

name: Paneer Spinach Skillet
steps: Brown paneer cubes in a skillet and set aside.
Cook onion, garlic, and cumin in the same pan.
Add spinach to wilt, return paneer, and cook 2 more minutes.

name: Turkey Zucchini Meatballs
steps: Mix turkey, grated zucchini, onion, breadcrumbs, egg, and oregano.
Form meatballs and place on an oiled sheet pan.

name: Tofu Peanut Noodle Stir-Fry
steps: Cook rice noodles and set aside.
Stir-fry carrot and cabbage, then add noodles and a sauce of peanut butter, soy sauce, and lime.

name: Salmon with Quinoa and Asparagus
steps: Cook quinoa according to package directions.
Roast salmon and asparagus at 400°F with olive oil, salt, and pepper for 12–15 minutes.
Serve salmon over quinoa with lemon juice.

name: Mushroom and Pea Risotto
steps: Sauté onion and mushrooms in olive oil.
Add arborio rice and toast for 1 minute.
Add broth gradually, stirring until creamy, then stir in peas and parmesan.

name: Chicken Fajita Bowl
steps: Sauté chicken strips with cumin until cooked.
Add pepper and onion, cook until tender, and serve over rice with lime.

name: Vegetable Fried Rice
steps: Heat sesame oil in a wok and sauté garlic and carrot.
Add peas and cooked rice and stir-fry on high heat.
Season with soy sauce and finish with green onion.

name: Eggplant Chickpea Stew
steps: Sauté onion and garlic in olive oil.
Add diced eggplant and cook until it softens.
Stir in chickpeas, paprika, and broth and simmer 15 minutes.

name: Garlic Shrimp and Zucchini Skillet
steps: Sauté garlic and chili flakes in olive oil.
Add shrimp and cook until pink.
Stir in zucchini slices and cook until tender-crisp, then finish with lemon and parsley.

name: White Bean Kale Pasta
steps: Cook pasta and reserve a little pasta water.
Sauté garlic and kale in olive oil until wilted.
Add beans, pasta, lemon, and pasta water; toss and finish with nutritional yeast.

name: Vegetarian Burrito Bowl
steps: Warm rice, beans, and corn separately.
Layer rice in bowls, then add beans and corn.
Top with avocado, yogurt, lime juice, and cilantro.

name: Chicken and Vegetable Soup
steps: Sauté onion, carrot, celery, and garlic in olive oil.
Add broth and diced chicken and bring to a simmer.
Cook 15 minutes until chicken is fully cooked.

name: Cauliflower Lentil Tacos
steps: Roast cauliflower with olive oil and cumin at 425°F for 20 minutes.
Warm lentils in a pan with a little salt and lime juice.
Fill tortillas with lentils, cauliflower, and sliced onion.

name: Spinach Feta Stuffed Portobellos
steps: Preheat oven to 400°F and remove mushroom stems.
Sauté spinach and garlic, then mix with feta and breadcrumbs.

name: Teriyaki Chicken Rice Bowl
steps: Sauté chicken pieces until nearly cooked.
Add garlic, ginger, soy sauce, and honey, then add broccoli and cook until glazed.

name: Zucchini Noodles with Walnut Pesto
steps: Blend basil, walnuts, garlic, olive oil, lemon juice, and salt into pesto.
Toss zucchini noodles with pesto and serve immediately.

name: Egg Fried Quinoa
steps: Scramble eggs in a hot pan and set aside.
Stir-fry carrot and peas in sesame oil.
Add quinoa, soy sauce, and eggs, then finish with green onion.

name: Baked Falafel Bowl
steps: Pulse chickpeas, parsley, garlic, onion, and cumin in a food processor.
Form small patties and brush with olive oil.
Bake at 400°F for 20 minutes and serve with tahini.

name: Turkey and Cabbage Stir-Fry
steps: Cook ground turkey in sesame oil until browned.
Add garlic, ginger, cabbage, and carrot.
Stir-fry until cabbage softens and finish with soy sauce.

name: Roasted Veggie Hummus Bowl
steps: Roast sweet potato, zucchini, and chickpeas with olive oil and paprika at 425°F for 25 minutes.
Top with roasted vegetables and finish with lemon juice.

name: Chicken Spinach Coconut Curry
steps: Sauté onion and garlic in olive oil until soft.
Add chicken pieces and cook until lightly browned.
Stir in curry powder and coconut milk, simmer 12 minutes, then add spinach.

name: Broccoli Cheddar Baked Potato
steps: Split potato and fill with broccoli, cheddar, and a spoon of yogurt.

name: Sardine Lemon Herb Toast
steps: Mash sardines lightly with olive oil, lemon zest, and pepper.
Spread on toast and top with parsley.

name: Cabbage Peanut Slaw Bowl
steps: Shred cabbage and carrot and slice cucumber.
Whisk peanut butter, lime juice, and soy sauce into a dressing.
Toss vegetables with dressing and top with sesame seeds.

name: Herbed Omelet with Mushrooms
steps: Sauté sliced mushrooms in olive oil until browned.
Whisk eggs with salt, pepper, and chives.
Pour eggs into pan, cook until set, and fold over mushrooms.

name: Scrambled Eggs with Avocado Toast
steps: Scramble eggs in a pan with olive oil.
Mash avocado and spread on toast, top with eggs.

name: Banana Oat Pancakes
steps: Blend all ingredients into a batter.

name: Egg and Cheese Breakfast Sandwich
steps: Assemble sandwich with cheese and eggs.

name: Chicken Salad Sandwich
steps: Mix chicken with mayo and celery.

name: Egg Fried Rice
steps: Add rice and soy sauce, then eggs.

name: Grilled Chicken Wrap
steps: Top with yogurt sauce and wrap.

name: Chicken Stir Fry
steps: Stir in soy sauce and cook until done.

name: Avocado Egg Bowl
steps: Serve eggs and avocado over rice.

name: Garlic Butter Shrimp
steps: Add shrimp and cook until pink.

name: Tomato Basil Soup
steps: Simmer 20 minutes and blend, then add basil.

name: Chicken Pasta Alfredo
steps: Make sauce with butter, garlic, cream, and parmesan, then combine.

name: Pasta Aglio e Olio
steps: Toss pasta with oil, chili, and parsley.

name: Chicken Noodle Soup
steps: Add noodles and cook until tender.

name: Caprese Salad
steps: Top with basil and olive oil.

name: Chicken Quesadilla
steps: Fill tortilla with chicken and cheese.

name: Mac and Cheese
steps: Make cheese sauce with butter, milk, and cheese.

name: Baked Sweet Potato
steps: Serve with olive oil and salt.

name: Vegetable Omelette
steps: Add eggs and cook until set.

name: Apple Cinnamon Oatmeal
steps: Sweeten with maple syrup and serve warm.

name: Rice Cake Peanut Snack
steps: Spread peanut butter on rice cakes.

name: Cheese and Crackers Plate
steps: Arrange cheese and crackers on a plate.

name: Pasta with Olive Oil
steps: Drain and mix with olive oil and salt.
